# dbaas_instance (Resource)

Experimental managed DBaaS instance. Catalog-qualified version, plan, topology, storage and source CIDRs can change in place. Import uses zone-uuid/instance-id. Name, engine and zone changes require replacement.

Import uses `ZONE_UUID/INSTANCE_ID`; omit creation metadata when adopting an
existing database. Import never creates or rotates credentials. In configuration,
`zone` may be the zone's name or its UUID: both select the same zone, and
switching between them does not replace the database.

A timeout or interrupted apply does not prove that no database was created.
Before retrying a failed creation, use the `dbaas_instances` data source to
check whether the database exists, wait for it to finish, and import it instead
of creating a second one. Do not rename the database to get past a name conflict.

Keep `prevent_destroy` enabled during normal operation and run application
provisioners in separate resources. Completed-resource taint follows normal OpenTofu replacement. Creation keys
are internal; process loss without saved identity requires discovery and import.

## Example

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    dbaas = { source = "locaweb/dbaas" }
  }
}

provider "dbaas" {}

variable "zone" { type = string }
variable "engine_version" { type = string }
variable "plan" { type = string }
variable "topology" { type = string }
variable "storage_gib" { type = number }
variable "source_cidrs" { type = set(string) }

resource "dbaas_instance" "application" {
  name         = "application-db"
  zone         = var.zone
  engine       = "postgresql"
  version      = var.engine_version
  plan         = var.plan
  topology     = var.topology
  storage_gib  = var.storage_gib
  source_cidrs = var.source_cidrs

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

output "host" { value = dbaas_instance.application.connection_info.host }
output "port" { value = dbaas_instance.application.connection_info.port }
```

## Schema

### Required

- `engine` (String) Catalog engine ID. Fresh creation follows server eligibility; withheld engines and versions are not admitted.
- `name` (String) Database name. Changes require replacement.
- `plan` (String) Catalog plan ID.
- `source_cidrs` (Set of String) Exact IPv4 ingress allowlist. Supply canonical CIDRs; /0 is prohibited.
- `storage_gib` (Number) Per-data-node storage in GiB. Use zero only for a catalog-advertised volatile-cache offer.
- `topology` (String) Catalog topology ID.
- `version` (String) Exact catalog engine version; no automatic upgrades.
- `zone` (String) Exact configured zone name or UUID. Routing remains bound to zone_id.

### Optional

- `credential_rotation_id` (String) Persistent unique intent for explicit application-credential rotation. Changing it rotates once after other changes complete. Retain it for retries; removing it does not rotate. Refresh/import never rotate.
- `expunge_on_destroy` (Boolean) Permanently end restore access and release the name after deletion. Defaults to false. Apply this setting before destroy or replacement; deletion uses its saved state value. Same-name create-before-destroy still requires a different name.
- `restore` (Attributes) Creation-only restore into a separate database in this zone. Settings and source CIDRs must initially match the source; omit all targets for catalog-supported latest recovery. Import may omit this metadata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restore))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) Operation wait overrides. Create includes restore/initial rotation; update includes all requested steps and rotation. HTTP requests remain separately bounded. Saved timeout values also govern later deletion. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Authenticated owning account. No tenant override is accepted.
- `api_endpoint` (String) Bound CloudStack API URL. Changing endpoints requires explicit adoption in a separate state.
- `connection_info` (Object) Non-secret public endpoint and TLS trust metadata. Never retrieves application credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_info))
- `creation_complete` (Boolean) Whether create converged or the database was explicitly imported. Failed creates require explicit recovery before deletion.
- `desired_generation` (Number) Desired specification generation.
- `id` (String) Durable DBaaS instance ID.
- `observed_generation` (Number) Reconciled specification generation.
- `operation_id` (String) Last accepted operation ID, or empty for an imported instance.
- `state` (String) Observed DBaaS lifecycle state.
- `zone_id` (String) Bound routing zone UUID.

<a id="nestedatt--restore"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restore`

Required:

- `source_instance_id` (String) Exact authorized source instance ID in the configured zone, including retained recovery after deletion.

Optional:

- `target_gtid` (String) Catalog-supported GTID recovery selector; mutually exclusive with other targets.
- `target_snapshot` (String) Recovery point ID returned by dbaas_recovery_points; mutually exclusive with other targets.
- `target_time` (String) RFC3339 recovery timestamp, only when advertised by the source version's catalog.

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `delete` (String) Positive duration such as 30m or 2h; defaults to the provider timeout.
- `update` (String) Positive duration such as 30m or 2h; defaults to the provider timeout.
